# Ice Lagoon pilot map / 冰河湖本地地图试点

Produced 2026-10-15 for Nordic Journal 2026. Region: 63.98–64.29 N, 16.55–15.72 W. Web Mercator (EPSG:3857). The backdrop contains no itinerary route or numbered markers.

## OpenStreetMap
Map geography © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under ODbL 1.0: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright / https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
The derived, clipped geographic database is distributed openly as geography.json under ODbL 1.0. No road or shoreline positions are invented. Raw fixed-region API extracts retrieved 2026-10-15: https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map . Breiðamerkurjökull relation 13566300 was retrieved in full to preserve its boundary.

## Elevation and relief
Raw elevation data: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles, accessed 2026-10-15 from https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/ . Raw Terrarium heights were decoded in EPSG:3857, hillshaded and tinted locally; no rendered third-party map tiles were downloaded or republished. Native source ground sampling here is approximately 17m, so the relief does not supply parking-space-scale terrain accuracy.

Iceland coverage may draw on ArcticDEM, EU-DEM, GMTED2010 and ETOPO1 in the source mosaic. Provider attribution and applicable terms: https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
- ArcticDEM: DEM(s) were created from DigitalGlobe, Inc., imagery and funded under National Science Foundation awards 1043681, 1559691, and 1542736. Current PGC distribution: CC BY 4.0, https://www.pgc.umn.edu/guides/stereo-derived-elevation-models/pgc-dem-products-arcticdem-rema-and-earthdem/
- Europe terrain data produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union – EU-DEM layers.
- Global ETOPO1 terrain data: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, DOC/NOAA/NESDIS/NCEI. US Government material is not subject to copyright protection within the United States.
- GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; the local hillshade and palette are modifications by Nordic Journal and do not imply USGS endorsement.

Own cartographic styling and relief images: CC BY 4.0. Geographic data retains ODbL. This is a planning map, not live turn-by-turn navigation or a current road-closure/ice-cave-access map. Existing Blue Iceland coordinates identify the meeting point; no cave entrance or glacier driving route has been added.
